component.name: aws2-timestream
component.title: AWS Timestream
component.description: Write records to and query the time-series data of Amazon Timestream for LiveAnalytics, and manage its databases, tables, batch load tasks and scheduled queries.
component.label: cloud,database

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints of the component start from. Each endpoint uses a copy of it, in which its own URI options replace the values.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs, which must be one of the clientType of the endpoint: the query and scheduled query operations for query, the others for write, and describeEndpoints for both. The CamelAwsTimestreamOperation header replaces this option.

overrideEndpoint.description: Whether to send the requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

pojoRequest.description: Whether the body is the request object of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a WriteRecordsRequest or a QueryRequest, which the producer sends as it is. The headers that give the input of the operation are then not used, and a body of another type fails the exchange.

profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

queryAllPages.label: producer
queryAllPages.description: For the query operation: read all the pages of the result, and give all the rows in one QueryResponse. Without it, the body is one page, and the CamelAwsTimestreamQueryNextToken header gives the token of the next page. Not used with pojoRequest.

region.description: The AWS region of Timestream, as a region ID such as eu-west-1, which is the value of Region.EU_WEST_1.id(). If not set, the AWS SDK takes the region from its default region provider chain, for example the AWS_REGION environment variable.

trustAllCertificates.description: Whether the HTTP client of Timestream trusts every TLS certificate without checking it. It applies to any endpoint, not only to an overridden one, so use it only for testing, for example against a local emulator.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

awsTimestreamQueryClient.label: advanced
awsTimestreamQueryClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.timestreamquery.TimestreamQueryClient for an endpoint of the query clientType; a write endpoint does not use it. When this option is set or autowired, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used. The Camel endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

awsTimestreamWriteClient.label: advanced
awsTimestreamWriteClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.timestreamwrite.TimestreamWriteClient for an endpoint of the write clientType; a query endpoint does not use it. When this option is set or autowired, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used. The Camel endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP client of Timestream connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP client of Timestream connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the HTTP client of Timestream uses to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. It is required, unless the client option of the clientType (awsTimestreamWriteClient or awsTimestreamQueryClient) is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. It is required, unless the client option of the clientType (awsTimestreamWriteClient or awsTimestreamQueryClient) is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options. When it is not set, the accessKey and secretKey options are used without a session token.

useSessionCredentials.label: security
useSessionCredentials.description: Whether to use temporary credentials made of the accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken options, for example those of an assumed IAM role. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

CamelAwsTimestreamOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs, as text or as a Timestream2Operations. It replaces the operation option.

CamelAwsTimestreamRecord.description: The common attributes of the writeRecords operation: the dimensions, measure and time values that all the records of the CamelAwsTimestreamRecordList header share. It is not written as a record of its own.

CamelAwsTimestreamRecordList.description: The records that writeRecords writes, as a List of the Record of the AWS SDK. Timestream accepts at most 100 records in one request.

CamelAwsTimestreamTaskStatus.description: The status of the batch load tasks that listBatchLoadTasks lists, such as IN_PROGRESS or SUCCEEDED, as text. If not set, the tasks of every status are listed.

CamelAwsTimestreamTaskId.description: The ID of the batch load task, for describeBatchLoadTask and resumeBatchLoadTask.

CamelAwsTimestreamDatabaseName.description: The name of the database, for the database operations except listDatabases, the table operations and writeRecords. For createScheduledQuery, the database of the table that the scheduled query writes its results to.

CamelAwsTimestreamTableName.description: The name of the table, for createTable, deleteTable, describeTable, updateTable and writeRecords. For createScheduledQuery, the table that the scheduled query writes its results to.

CamelAwsTimestreamTargetDatabaseName.description: The name of the database that the batch load task of createBatchLoadTask loads the data into.

CamelAwsTimestreamTargetTableName.description: The name of the table that the batch load task of createBatchLoadTask loads the data into.

CamelAwsTimestreamRecordVersion.description: The version that createBatchLoadTask gives to the records it loads. A record with a higher version replaces the measure value of an existing record of the same time series and time.

CamelAwsTimestreamDataModelConfiguration.description: The data model of the batch load task of createBatchLoadTask, which maps the columns of the source data to the dimensions, measures and time of the records, as a DataModelConfiguration of the AWS SDK.

CamelAwsTimestreamDataSourceConfiguratio.description: The source data of the batch load task of createBatchLoadTask: its S3 location and its format, as a DataSourceConfiguration of the AWS SDK.

CamelAwsTimestreamReportConfiguration.description: The S3 location where the batch load task of createBatchLoadTask writes its error report, as a ReportConfiguration of the AWS SDK.

CamelAwsTimestreamTableSchema.description: The schema of the table for createTable and updateTable, which defines its composite partition key, as a Schema of the AWS SDK.

CamelAwsTimestreamRetentionProperties.description: How long the memory store and the magnetic store of the table keep the data, for createTable and updateTable, as a RetentionProperties of the AWS SDK.

CamelAwsTimestreamMagneticStoreWriteProp.description: Whether the table accepts writes of records that are older than the retention of its memory store, and where Timestream reports the rejected records, for createTable and updateTable, as a MagneticStoreWriteProperties of the AWS SDK.

CamelAwsTimestreamTimeColumn.description: The column of the query result that gives the time of the records that the scheduled query of createScheduledQuery writes.

CamelAwsTimestreamMeasureColumnName.description: The column of the query result that gives the measure name of the records that the scheduled query of createScheduledQuery writes.

CamelAwsTimestreamDimensionMappingList.description: The columns of the query result that are the dimensions of the records that the scheduled query of createScheduledQuery writes, as a List of the DimensionMapping of the AWS SDK.

CamelAwsTimestreamMultiMeasureMappings.description: How the scheduled query of createScheduledQuery maps the columns of the query result to multi-measure records, as a MultiMeasureMappings of the AWS SDK. Use it or the CamelAwsTimestreamMixedMeasureMappingList header.

CamelAwsTimestreamMixedMeasureMappingLis.description: How the scheduled query of createScheduledQuery maps the measures of the query result to records, as a List of the MixedMeasureMapping of the AWS SDK. Use it or the CamelAwsTimestreamMultiMeasureMappings header.

CamelAwsTimestreamScheduledQueryName.description: The name of the scheduled query that createScheduledQuery creates.

CamelAwsTimestreamScheduledQueryArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the scheduled query, for deleteScheduledQuery, executeScheduledQuery, updateScheduledQuery and describeScheduledQuery.

CamelAwsTimestreamScheduledQueryState.description: The state that updateScheduledQuery sets on the scheduled query: ENABLED or DISABLED, as text.

CamelAwsTimestreamScheduledQueryInvocati.description: The time of the run that executeScheduledQuery starts: Timestream runs the query as if it was invoked at this time.

CamelAwsTimestreamQueryString.description: The SQL query, for query and prepareQuery, or the query that the scheduled query of createScheduledQuery runs.

CamelAwsTimestreamQueryId.description: The ID of the query that cancelQuery cancels, as given in the QueryResponse of query.

CamelAwsTimestreamQueryValidateOnly.description: Whether prepareQuery only validates the query string, without storing the prepared query for later use.

CamelAwsTimestreamQueryMaxRows.description: The maximum number of rows in one page of the result of query. If not set, Timestream returns as many rows as fit in a page of 1 MB.

CamelAwsTimestreamQueryNextToken.description: The token of a page of a query result. As input, the query operation reads the page of this token; as output, it is the token of the next page, and it is removed after the last page. Set the same query string to read the next page.

CamelAwsTimestreamMaxResults.description: The maximum number of items that listBatchLoadTasks, listDatabases, listTables and listScheduledQueries return. The response holds one page only, with a nextToken when there are more.

CamelAwsTimestreamScheduleExpression.description: The schedule of the scheduled query that createScheduledQuery creates, as a cron or rate expression, for example rate(1 hour).

CamelAwsTimestreamNotificationTopicArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon SNS topic that receives the notifications of the scheduled query that createScheduledQuery creates.

CamelAwsTimestreamErrorReportS3BucketNam.description: The name of the S3 bucket that the scheduled query of createScheduledQuery writes its error reports to. The other CamelAwsTimestreamErrorReportS3 headers are used only when it is set.

CamelAwsTimestreamErrorReportS3ObjectKey.description: The prefix of the object keys of the error reports of the scheduled query of createScheduledQuery. Used only with the CamelAwsTimestreamErrorReportS3BucketName header.

CamelAwsTimestreamErrorReportS3Encryptio.description: How S3 encrypts the error reports of the scheduled query of createScheduledQuery: SSE_S3 or SSE_KMS, as text. Used only with the CamelAwsTimestreamErrorReportS3BucketName header.

CamelAwsTimestreamScheduledQueryExecutio.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role that Timestream assumes to run the scheduled query that createScheduledQuery creates.

CamelAwsTimestreamClientToken.description: A token that makes createBatchLoadTask, createScheduledQuery and executeScheduledQuery idempotent: a repeated request with the same token has the same result. If not set, the AWS SDK generates one for each request.

CamelAwsTimestreamKmsKeyId.description: The AWS KMS key that encrypts at rest the database of createDatabase and updateDatabase, or the scheduled query of createScheduledQuery.

producerIn.description: Not used: the operations of both client types take their input from headers, such as the records of writeRecords in CamelAwsTimestreamRecordList, a List of the Record of the AWS SDK, and the SQL of query in CamelAwsTimestreamQueryString. With pojoRequest=true the request of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a WriteRecordsRequest or a QueryRequest: another body fails

producerOut.description: The response of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as the WriteRecordsResponse of writeRecords, or the QueryResponse of query with one page of rows: the CamelAwsTimestreamQueryNextToken header gives the next page, and queryAllPages=true gives the rows of all the pages

clientType.description: The type of the client: write for the databases, tables, batch load tasks and records of the Write API of Amazon Timestream for LiveAnalytics, or query for the queries and scheduled queries of its Query API. describeEndpoints is an operation of both.

label.description: A logical name of the endpoint, which you choose freely. The producer does not use it: the database, table or query to act on is given in headers.
